# `csharp_space_before_open_square_brackets`

Space before an opening square bracket.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_space_before_open_square_brackets = true`

```ini
csharp_space_before_open_square_brackets = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Get()
    {
        int[] arr = new int[10];
        arr[0] = 1;
        return arr[0];
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int Get()
    {
        int [] arr = new int [10];
        arr [0] = 1;
        return arr [0];
    }
}
```
:::

::::
